executive_request: Generate n=5 candidate architectures for a durable-execution substrate that lets lane work survive worker/VM death, drafted from the Temporal ecosystem as seeds through the repo's existing starter templates, and run the full Oracle Method cycle: cross-vote round 1 with the recorded expectations, an implementation round gated on the kill-and-resume proof (RFP §6), a DoE 2^4 factorial slice, and round 2 on an equalized evidence base with calibration deltas to the weighting/outcome ledgers.

expectations.rationale: V1 alone answers the fleet loss mode head-on with a runnable no-key starter; V2 rides in-repo integrations; V4 cheap/composable but adds no durability itself; V3 actuation is K8s-gated; V5 execution is owner-gated, only its form scores.
expectations.recorded_by: temporal-recon lane at G0 intake, pre-implementation

items.text: Generate 5 candidate packs (MANIFEST/ITEMS) under docs/proposals/active/, one per variant, each declaring its seed combination and plan.
Cross-vote round 1 across all 5 variants, source classes separate, against the input expectations recorded in INTAKE.md.

Implementation round: extend scripts/temporal/hello_workflow.py into the RFP §6 kill-and-resume harness (self-host dev server, remote/Codespace); per-variant test suites require run receipts or score zero.

DoE slice: 2^4 factorial (substrate x attestation x placement x routing) with fixed contract hash, env fingerprint, benchmark version and deterministic scorer; publish canonical rows (cohort x task x arm x repetition, workflow/run IDs as trace identity).
Round 2 on the equalized evidence bundle (sha256-stamped), re-vote, calibration deltas to ledgers #1489/#1487.
Add research-seed records: Temporal set + getDX (evidence-pending) under docs/repositories/research-seeds/, Gravitee precedent.
G6 disposition record: adopt/pilot/reference-only/reject per variant and per seed repo, naming the best piece taken, what was learned, and which N1-N7 inventions (RFP §7) survive.

summary_points.point: All 19 supplied Temporal links validated live 2026-10-27: 17 repos, none archived, 15 of 17 pushed the same day.
In-repo Temporal footprint is P1 smoke only (hello workflow + LangSmith adapter); no production workflow and no kill-resume evidence exists yet.

Four-plane composition: Bifrost = request plane (proposal + partial slice), Gravitee = publication plane (research seed only), Temporal = time plane, getDX = measurement plane with zero in-repo presence (seed before any claim), Witness attests across planes with the evidence envelope canonical.
MoneyBall weights fixed at G0 intake: relevance 0.30, evidence maturity 0.25, survivability proof 0.20, adoption cost inverse 0.15, composability 0.10; scores must be explained per candidate.
Owner gates: no Temporal Cloud/AWS/GCP account or payment instrument (serverless execution paths specified_not_run), no vendoring, remote-first, credentials names-only.

title: Durable execution substrate for the lane fleet (Temporal four-plane RFP)

variants.claim: Agent-agnostic durable core: session-file state, worker death mid-turn resumed by another worker, started-but-unrecorded side effects surfaced as unknown outcome and never blindly retried.
test_suites: kill-resume harness (RFP §6) on the echo-style starter: complete with exactly one receipt after a mid-activity worker kill

variants.claim: Cookbook recipes as starters (agentic loop, HITL approval pause, deep-research, durable MCP) with plugin-per-framework packaging; LangSmith bridge already in-repo.
test_suites: HITL approval workflow: pause on signal, resume, complete

variants.claim: Worker Versioning + backlog-driven autoscaling (WCI) as the actuation layer for MoneyBall/quota routing decisions; K8s actuation itself specified_not_run (no cluster), the versioning/autoscale model and omes load evidence are the claims.
test_suites: omes load scenario against the self-host dev server with published scenario receipts

variants.claim: Proto/schema-first lane contracts with nexgen-style generated typed models + shared validators, and workflow history treated as the projection/audit surface.
test_suites: contract generation fixture: evidence-envelope schema -> validators in 2 languages, invalid payloads rejected with aggregated violations

variants.claim: The agent skill as the deployment starter (scope -> access checks -> packaging -> registration -> verification -> rollback); all Cloud execution paths specified_not_run under the card rule.
test_suites: skill dry-walk against the self-host dev server only; Cloud steps recorded specified_not_run with reasons
